query:
UPDATE intelligence_artifacts
                    SET artifact_kind = $2::varchar,
                        scope = $3::varchar,
                        library_id = $4,
                        user_id = $5,
                        media_id = $6,
                        media_type = ($7::text)::media_type,
                        run_id = $8,
                        title = $9,
                        summary = $10,
                        excerpt = $11,
                        content = $12::jsonb,
                        metadata = $13::jsonb,
                        source_revision = $14,
                        source_updated_at = now(),
                        content_hash = $15,
                        status = 'active',
                        invalidated_at = NULL,
                        invalidation_reason = NULL,
                        updated_at = now()
                    WHERE id = $1
                      AND (($5::uuid IS NULL AND user_id IS NULL) OR user_id = $5)
